nodes.label: semantic_compression
nodes.summary: Embedding dimensionality reduction via chunk-average pooling. Single public function `compress_embedding(&[f32], new_dim) -> Vec<f32>` that divides a high-dimensional embedding vector into `new_dim` equal chunks and replaces each chunk with its mean. Zero-allocation path when new_dim==0 or input is empty. Used by PerceptionAdapter for PCA decorrelation output compression.
nodes.notes: Pure, no external deps. Has inline unit test `compress_basic`.

nodes.label: snapshot_manager
nodes.summary: Filesystem snapshot/rollback for MemoryStore data files using flate2 + tar. `SnapshotManager::save` archives a single file as `<name>.<tag>.tar.gz`; `load` unpacks an archive to a destination directory; `rollback_to_latest` looks for `<name>.latest.tar.gz` and unpacks in-place. Stateless struct (no fields) — all methods are static. Used by MemoryStore crash-recovery and by the CLI rollback command.

nodes.label: source_trust
nodes.summary: Bayesian source credibility tracking using Beta distribution (Beta(alpha,beta)). `SourceTrustProfile` maintains per-source alpha/beta counts; corroboration increments alpha, contradiction increments beta, posterior mean alpha/(alpha+beta) is the trust score. `SourceTrustRegistry` is a HashMap<String, SourceTrustProfile> registry with get-or-create semantics, bulk decay, admin override, and geometric-mean trust-weighting of raw confidence scores. Sources start at neutral 0.5 (Beta(1,1) uniform prior). Decay exponentially regresses alpha/beta toward 1.0 for sources inactive beyond max_days. Designed to be held behind Arc<RwLock<>>.
nodes.notes: Anti-adversarial memory injection guard. Integrates with search result weighting via trust_weighted_score (geometric mean). 7 unit tests cover neutral, corroboration, contradiction, decay, override, bounded trust, and listing.

nodes.label: web_server
nodes.summary:
Axum 0.6 REST API server (feature `web-server`). Wires all HipCortex subsystems into a single `AppState<B>` and exposes ~60 routes across 9 functional groups. Entry points: `run(addr)` (symbolic-only), `run_with_memory(addr, store)`, `run_with_state(addr, state)` (full intelligence layer). API key auth parsed from `HIPCORTEX_API_KEYS` env (format `key:tier,...`). Three tiers: Free (10K rec/mo), Pro (1M rec/mo), Team (unlimited + GDPR).

Route groups:
- Memory CRUD: POST /memory/add, /memory/bulk, /memory/embed, /memory/ingest (zero-config), GET /memory/query, /memory/latest, PATCH /memory/update/:id, DELETE /memory/:id
- Memory search: POST /memory/search (embedding+keyword), GET /memory/search-flat, /memory/search/related (PageRank), /memory/context, /memory/live_beliefs
- Memory lifecycle: /memory/consolidate, /memory/export, /memory/forget/:actor (GDPR), /memory/quarantine/:id, /memory/restore/:id, /memory/corroborate/:id, /memory/contradict/:id
- Memory graph: POST /memory/link, GET /memory/neighbors/:id
- Memory reflexion: POST /memory/reflect, /memory/hypotheses, /memory/hypotheses/reset
- Graph store: GET/POST /graph, /graph/node, /graph/edge, /graph/search, DELETE /graph/node/:id, GET /node/:id
- World model: GET /worldmodel/status, /worldmodel/states, /worldmodel/transitions, /worldmodel/uncertainty, /worldmodel/entities, POST /worldmodel/observe, /worldmodel/predict, /worldmodel/rollout, /worldmodel/entity, /worldmodel/causal, /worldmodel/causal/edge, /worldmodel/causal/intervention, /worldmodel/causal/counterfactual, GET /predict/entity/:id
- Coherence: GET /coherence/status, /coherence/inconsistencies, POST /coherence/check, /coherence/resolve/:id
- Self-model: GET /self/health, /self/capabilities, /self/can-execute, POST /decide/batch
- Topological memory: POST /topo/ppr, /topo/check-edge, /topo/deconstruct, /topo/apply-hyp
- Audit: GET /audit/verify, /audit/export
- Webhooks: GET/POST /webhooks, DELETE /webhooks/:id
- Regulatory: GET/POST /regulatory/hold, DELETE /regulatory/hold/:actor
- Meta: GET /health, /health/summary, /metrics, /stats, /tier, /pricing, /openapi.json, /ns

nodes.label: coherence/mod
nodes.summary: Cross-module consistency coordinator for the HipCortex intelligence layer. Four components: (1) CoherenceChecker — central coordinator running a background 60s check cycle, gates writes, exposes metrics; (2) ConsistencyChecker — detects 5 inconsistency types (TemporalSymbolicConflict, ProceduralWorldConflict, CausalInconsistency, EntityPermanenceViolation, BeliefSymbolicInconsistency); (3) ConflictResolver — 3 strategies (Consensus/majority vote, Recency/newest wins, Confidence/highest score wins) plus manual override; (4) SystemInvariants — enforces 4 mathematical invariants: Memory Consistency (temporal_count==symbolic_count, critical), Decay Monotonicity (activation non-increasing, non-critical), Graph Acyclicity (DAG enforcement, critical), Conservation (created-deleted==net_change, non-critical). State held via Arc<RwLock<>>; locking order must be respected. Critical invariant violations halt operations.
nodes.notes: 626 lines total. CoT block at top of file (canonical shape per CLAUDE.md). Arc<RwLock<>> shared state — deadlock risk if locking order not respected. Exposed via /coherence/* REST endpoints in web_server.
